4 ازعلهُ [in the CK erroneously written زاعَلَهُ] It (pasture, and fatness, TA) rendered him [i. e. a beast] brisk, lively, sprightly, active, agile, prompt, and quick. (S, K, TA.) ―
-b2- And ازعلهُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ He, or it, removed him, or unsettled him, from his place. (Ibn-' Abbád, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
